english.title: Person accepting bets fails to produce copy of authorisation - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), while holding yourself out as willing to accept bets on behalf of the holder of an operating licence issued under section 65(1) of the Gambling Act 2005, failed without reasonable excuse to produce a copy of your authorisation under section

(A)_[93(2)]_
(B)_[93(3)]_
(C)_[94(2)]_

of the Gambling Act 2005 after having been required by

(D)_[a constable]_
(E)_[anenforcement officer]_

to do so

(F)_[within a specified period, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD..)]_
(G)_[immediately]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 316(2), (5) and (6) of the Gambling Act 2005.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The authorisations under sections 93(2) or (3) and 94(2) of the Gambling Act 2005 may be given by pool betting operating licence holders.
(ii) The "specified period" is set by the constable or enforcement officer making the request.
